english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a brief, unspecified period, as in waiting a moment.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an unspecified, usually short period of time.
This is the all-purpose choice for an unspecified short wait or moment, rather than the precise unit 秒.
Use this for an unspecified short while, as in asking someone to give you a minute.
Use this for a short while or moment, especially when English means something will happen very soon.

examples.english: Wait a moment for me first.

examples.english: Wait a minute and I’ll be back.
